posts.body:
Offscreen Tracker System
Features:
- Target Tracking: Arrow rotates to point at the target, while the attached Text and Icon remain horizontal for readability.
- Distance Display: Optionally shows real-time distance to the target that updates as the player moves.
- UI Positioning: The label group (Icon + Name) automatically anchors to the arrow's tail based on the current rotation angle.
Download and Terms of Use:
https://vishi221.itch.io/rpg-maker-mvmz-offscreen-tracker
